prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original SOULMONSTERS environment concept panorama, PALAFITAS contemporary raised-water neighborhood in Kronasta. Wide 16:9 high three-quarter overview, inviting distinctive coastal wetland architecture. CLEAN 2D MANGA crisp economical ink, flat local colors, simple hard cel shadows, sparse surface details, no photorealism or painterly noise. NOT a rustic shantytown, fantasy dock village or duplicate of a fishing port. This is a present-day residential community on engineered piers.
Compose THREE connected raised neighborhoods over deep blue-green tidal channels, linked by WIDE practical pedestrian decks with railings, clear dry routes and structural supports visible. Foreground arrival from firm shore on left: open public deck with simple transit/boarding stop, compact cream/cobalt community services kiosk, a sail-and-fabric repair workshop with wide glazing and a folded orange fabric shade. Middle houses: four unique SMALL contemporary one- or two-storey homes in separate footprints raised on reinforced concrete piles and navy steel cross beams, ventilated space below above water. Modern white stucco, pale turquoise, terracotta and cobalt accents, mixed asymmetrical metal roofs, roof solar panels, glass/slatted windows, recessed balconies, small planted boxes. Houses separated by breathing spaces and water gaps, no buildings fused into one wall. Outdoor AC, sealed utility conduit under deck, individual access gates. No straw, bamboo shacks, stilt logs pretending to support concrete.
Main deck leaves foreground square, rises by FOUR broad supported steps to a higher small neighborhood landing then crosses one short flat steel pedestrian bridge over channel into rear residential plaza. Also a continuous separate sloped ramp route to same landing. EVERY deck has believable beams and vertical piles entering water, deck thickness visible. All stairs pass THROUGH openings with no wall or rail blocking landing. No disconnected platforms, rails ending in air or stairs into water except clearly separate boarding steps.
Two distinct rear destinations: LEFT modest rounded open COURT on a larger engineered concrete pier with independent pile grid and bracing, two tamer positions, small scoreboard, camera and lightweight navy spectator canopy for champion CAIO GARCA; RIGHT quiet open overlook with slender signal mast and TWO clear exits, intended for a personal encounter where the creature can freely leave. These spaces must be physically SEPARATE with a connecting circulation route, not the same arena. No creatures or closeup character portraits. A roofed maintenance bay under a taller landward structure holds spare deck boards and metal rail parts, reflecting walkway caretaker role. Sail workshop contains rolled technical fabric and sewing table, not old ship sails everywhere.
Water is below decks with visible drop and dark depth; sparse small canoe/modern utility skiff moored at a separate low landing. Boardwalk top surfaces pale mineral composite or light treated boards with very few seams, no noisy plank texture. Mangrove-type vegetation confined to distant firm banks and tiny soil islets, no decorative trees in deep water. Contemporary urban skyline muted in distance, natural coastal hills, warm daylight. Palette cream/cobalt/turquoise/terracotta, navy supports, teal water. Quiet floor areas, asymmetrical architectural silhouettes, selective kite-culture through a couple small functional fabric wind indicators at workshop/mast. No giant kite buildings, no medieval ornament, HUD, text, labels, watermark or logos. Prioritize structural clarity, lived-in warmth, modern technology and clean collectible-game manga environment art.
